summary: UTime Ltd filed a 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a $1.2 million best-efforts registered direct offering of 200,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.20 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase 800,000 shares at $0.70 each. This is a routine capital raising under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The company intends to use net proceeds for working capital. No activist, M&A, or restructuring event. The filing is a standard follow-on offering by a foreign private issuer.
